modules.module_title: Coordinate the construction of goat/sheep sheds

pcs.pc_description: select a suitable area for rearing goats/sheep, ensuring adequate space for growing grass and plants for goats/sheep
arrange the required material, tools and equipment for the construction of goat/sheep sheds
select an appropriate area in the goat/sheep farm for the construction of appropriate types of sheds, e.g. general flock shed (ewe/doe shed), ram/buck shed, lambing/kidding shed, lamb/kid shed, etc.
coordinate with the relevant expert for the construction of sheds, ensuring adequate space, ventilation and protection from varied weather conditions
ensure the flooring in the sheds is suitable for goats/sheep
install the goat feeder at the recommended height for the convenient feeding of goats/sheep
ensure effective drainage arrangements to prevent waterlogging in the sheds
build and repair fences to keep animals contained and safe
check the goat/sheep sheds regularly to identify the repair and maintenance needs
carry out appropriate repair and maintenance or coordinate with an expert, as required
carry out fumigation in the goat/sheep sheds
remove animal waste from the sheds regularly and disinfect the sheds using the recommended disinfectants
perform regular cleaning of the goat/sheep feeder and water pans
select the appropriate legume, grass and tree fodder crops to be grown for goat/sheep feed, e.g. hedge lucerne, cowpea, fodder maize, neem, agathi, etc.
prepare the designated land through ploughing and levelling for the cultivation of the selected fodder crops on the goat/sheep farm
irrigate the crop with the recommended quantity as per the irrigation schedule
apply the recommended organic and inorganic fertilizers to achieve a healthy growth of the fodder crop
follow the appropriate preventive measures to protect the crop from pest and disease infestation
identify pest and disease infestation in the crop and apply the recommended treatment to the crop
identify the maturity indices of the crops and harvest them using the appropriate tools and implements
carry out post-harvest processing of the harvested crops, e.g. threshing, as required
store the harvested crops safely and hygienically in the designated storage, maintaining the recommended temperature and humidity
check the stored crop regularly and take appropriate corrective measures to deal with quality-related issues

pcs.pc_description: select the appropriate goat/sheep breeds for rearing based on their adaptability to the prevailing climatic conditions, the purpose of rearing and the relevant feeding management system
procure young goats/sheep of the selected breeds in the required number from a reliable breeder, ensuring they are pure-bred with high genetic merit
check the goats/sheep being procured are vaccinated for the Peste des Petits Ruminants (PPR) plague
tag the procured goats/ sheep for their identification
use the recommended ingredients, e.g. green leguminous roughage and grasses/tender tree leaves, in the goat/sheep feed to ensure their nutrient requirements are met
supplement the sheep feed with the recommended quantity of sulphur to improve wool and meat production
determine and follow the recommended feed requirements for the fattening of goats/ sheep for meat production
feed colostrum to newborn kids/lambs as per the recommendation
monitor the kids/lamb for correct suckling and feeding
follow the appropriate colostrum and creep feeding schedule for kids/lambs
follow the recommended practices to induce optimum lactation in female goats/sheep
feed supplement concentrate ration in pellet or mesh form to goats/sheep as per the requirement, ensuring it has an appropriate quantity of nutrients
follow the semi-intensive feed management system to achieve better goat/sheep production
water the goats/sheep according to their age and water requirements
follow the recommended preventive measures to protect goats/sheep from diseases and disorders, e.g. regular cleaning of goats/sheep and maintaining dry sheds
maintain the stock of necessary vaccines and first aid kit for goats/sheep through consultation with the veterinarian
ensure appropriate vaccinations for goats/sheep at the appropriate stages of their growth
carry out deworming in goats/sheep by administering them the recommended anthelmintic drug in an appropriate dose
carry out drenching in goats/sheep using the recommended coccidiosis drug at an appropriate age to prevent coccidiosis infestation
carry out dipping in goats/sheep in the appropriate weather to prevent the ectoparasite infestation
practice drug rotation to prevent drug resistance in goats/sheep
identify and segregate goats/sheep to be dehorned
carry out dehorning of the identified goats/sheep following the appropriate procedure
perform hoof trimming for goats/sheep using the appropriate tools and equipment
identify the symptoms of diseases and disorders in goats/sheep, such as reduced feed intake, abnormal discharge, abnormal behaviour, etc.
treat the common diseases and disorders by administering the appropriate treatment to goats/sheep and coordinate with a veterinarian to treat serious diseases and disorders
maintain the kids/lambs and sick goats/sheep in separate sheds to provide them with the necessary care
identify and cull the poor-performing and aged goats/sheep to maintain high productivity at the goat/sheep farm
maintain the appropriate records concerning the identification and treatment of diseases and disorders in goats/sheep
adhere to animal welfare laws, biosecurity measures, and food safety regulations
maintain logs for health, breeding, birth, and production (milk/wool/meat)
harvest the goat/sheep produce, e.g. milk, wool and hide
select mature and healthy goats/sheep for marketing
identify the appropriate buyers for goats/sheep and their produce and negotiate with them to secure a profitable price
arrange an appropriate mode of transport to deliver goats/sheep and their produce to the buyers
process the payments using an appropriate payment method, including the e-payment method
budget, track expenses and income, and plan for seasonal fluctuations
maintain the manual and/or electronic records concerning the marketing activities
